FIELDS.NAME: Stitch & Sew Essentials
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Stitch & Sew Essentials, we operate a retail store dedicated to providing high-quality fabrics, sewing supplies, and related notions for hobbyists and professionals alike. Our core operations include the sale of a diverse range of fabrics, tools, and accessories necessary for various sewing projects. We also host sewing classes and workshops aimed at engaging our community and enhancing the skills of our customers. Our commitment to safety is paramount; we ensure that our store is equipped with adequate fire safety measures and provide regular employee training in safety protocols. We do not allow subcontractors to operate without valid certificates of insurance to reduce liability exposure. Our focus on maintaining compliance with local, state, and federal regulations aligns with our dedication to creating a safe and welcoming environment for all.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any activities involving significant quantities of flammable materials and confirms that adequate fire suppression systems are in place. Furthermore, all subcontractors and class instructors maintain their own insurance, and the business has a clean claims history, ensuring there are no concerns regarding frequent or severe claims. Additionally, our location is not in a high-crime area, eliminating the need for enhanced security measures.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Stitch & Sew Creations, LLC - A small custom sewing service providing alterations and bespoke garment creation.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 10, 2023, a minor fire incident occurred in our store due to an electrical malfunction in a sewing machine, resulting in damage estimated at $1,250. The fire department responded promptly, and we had adequate fire safety measures in place, including extinguishers and clear evacuation plans. This incident has been resolved, and we have conducted further training with our staff to reinforce safety protocols. Status: Resolved.
FIELDS.Bodily Injury & Prop Damage Occurrrence: $1,000,000 per occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate with a $1,000 deductible.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class 1, Grade B, Fire Rated Label
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central Station Alarm System and security cameras installed throughout the premises, along with nightly inspections of the facility to enhance overall security.
